question: In nursing students, is virtual reality-based teaching more effective than traditional or alternative teaching methods for improving theoretical knowledge, practical skills, skill retention, satisfaction, and critical thinking?
source: Health-professions (nursing) education systematic review + meta-analysis: Liu et al., 'Effectiveness of virtual reality in nursing education', BMC Med Educ 2023;23:710 (PMID 37770884, doi 10.1186/s12909-023-04662-x). Education-adjacent-health topic chosen for PubMed reachability; gold = 6/12 included RCTs that are MEDLINE-indexed (6 Chinese-language included studies are PubMed-unreachable).
gold_adjudication: Finally-included studies of the source meta-analysis (12 RCTs, refs 20-31); gold = the 6 MEDLINE-indexed studies, each title-verified against Table 1 (DOIs in the reference list were mis-parsed and could not be trusted). The other 6 included RCTs are Chinese-language journals (Yuan 2019 Nurs Res; X Wang 2023 China High Med Educ; P Wang 2020 China Nurs Manage; L Li 2017 Electron J Clin Med Lit; H Zhao 2022 Mod Hosp; N Cao 2021 Health Prof Educ) not indexed in PubMed.
notes: Created with make_fixture.py. No baseline strategy: use evals/generate.py (Phase 2). Harness reports reachable vs. unreachable gold separately.

version_change.reason: Initial evaluation protocol for the VR-in-nursing-education recall fixture.
version_change.decision_source: Evaluation fixture author; scope derived from Liu et al. 2023 (BMC Med Educ, PMID 37770884).

review.question: In nursing students, is virtual reality-based teaching more effective than traditional or alternative teaching methods for improving theoretical knowledge, practical skills, skill retention, satisfaction, and critical thinking?

framework.name: PICO
framework.rationale: An effectiveness question comparing an educational intervention against usual teaching; PICO cleanly separates the population and intervention (which drive retrieval) from the comparator and outcomes (which are screening-only, to protect recall).

slots.label: Population
slots.description: Nursing students in pre- or post-registration nursing education.

slots.label: Intervention
slots.description: Virtual reality or virtual simulation used as a teaching or learning method.

slots.label: Comparator
slots.description: Traditional, conventional, or alternative teaching methods.

slots.label: Outcome
slots.description: Learning outcomes: knowledge, practical skills, skill retention, satisfaction, critical thinking.

inclusion.label: Nursing students
inclusion.description: Participants are nursing students in a nursing education programme (undergraduate/pre-registration or postgraduate).

inclusion.label: Virtual reality teaching
inclusion.description: The intervention delivers education or training through virtual reality, immersive simulation, or a virtual patient/environment.

inclusion.label: Traditional or alternative teaching
inclusion.description: Comparison against traditional/conventional teaching or an alternative (e.g. non-immersive) instructional method.

inclusion.label: Educational outcome reported
inclusion.description: Reports at least one learning outcome: knowledge, practical/clinical skills, skill retention, satisfaction, self-efficacy, or critical thinking.

inclusion.label: Comparative interventional design
inclusion.description: A randomized controlled trial or otherwise controlled comparative educational intervention.

exclusion.label: Non-nursing population
exclusion.description: Participants are not nursing students (e.g. medical, allied-health, or qualified staff only).

exclusion.label: Not virtual reality
exclusion.description: The intervention is not virtual reality or virtual simulation (e.g. mannequin-only simulation, e-learning without a virtual environment).

exclusion.label: Not an educational context
exclusion.description: Virtual reality is used for patient therapy, rehabilitation, or clinical care rather than for teaching nursing students.

concepts.label: Nursing students / nursing education
concepts.definition: The population and setting: nursing students within nursing education. Retrieval must not depend on any single phrasing of 'nursing student'.
concepts.rationale: A stable essential concept; every eligible record concerns nursing students, so it anchors the search without threatening recall.

concepts.label: Virtual reality / virtual simulation
concepts.definition: The intervention: virtual reality, immersive/virtual simulation, or a virtual patient/environment used for teaching. Includes head-mounted-display, augmented, and mixed-reality variants.
concepts.rationale: A stable essential concept representing the technology under study; its vocabulary is varied (VR, virtual simulation, virtual patient, immersive), so it needs broad synonym expansion.

properties.label: Comparator is traditional/alternative teaching
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that the study compares VR against traditional/conventional or an alternative teaching method. Do not add a comparator AND block to the search.
properties.recall_rationale: Comparator terms are inconsistently reported and often absent from titles/abstracts; making them a search block would silently drop eligible trials.

properties.label: Reports a learning outcome
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that a knowledge, skill, retention, satisfaction, self-efficacy, or critical-thinking outcome is reported. Do not add an outcome AND block.
properties.recall_rationale: Outcome vocabulary is highly varied and frequently not in the abstract; an outcome block is a classic recall bottleneck.

properties.label: Controlled comparative design
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that the study is an RCT or otherwise controlled comparative educational intervention. Apply no methodological search filter.
properties.recall_rationale: Design filters/hedges miss poorly indexed education trials; screen for design instead of filtering the search.

decisions.label: Methodological (study-design) filter
decisions.rationale: Recall-first evaluation build; study design is handled at screening, not by a search-time hedge that could drop eligible education trials.

decisions.label: Database limits
decisions.rationale: No language, age, species, publication-status, or full-text limits are authorized for the evaluation build.

date_boundaries.rationale: No date boundaries; the evaluation scores against a fixed gold set and applies no date limit.

recall.policy: Recall first; decline the optional no-seed heuristic during evaluation because hidden gold is scored independently.

workload.policy: Do not narrow solely because retrieval is large.
workload.selection_rule: Workload may choose only among variants that meet the held-out recall requirement.

protocol_status: tightened; lock-validated and compiled (protocol_tool.py validate --mode lock + compile)
